provenance: Specific map and diocesan/custodian references, plus previously vetted P55 source fields. Individual case review does not certify full field geometry or current site operation.
caveats: Do not equate 55/55 carry-over source records with new independently researched cases.
A named OSM way with building tags is a candidate for exact footprint, not a production-ready authorization.
All source URLs and OSM refs explicitly recorded; where no exact OSM way is confirmed, leave null.
Historic Catholic significance does not imply presently Roman Catholic worship; religious precincts, monuments, tombs, grottoes, monasteries and churches need separate geometry types.
No photographs, paid services, TLM schedules, or production canonical registry changes.
